_source.how: docker run -d --network none <image> sleep, then docker exec of each command; the repository is one package, zzhello 1.0, in /repo (sources.list `deb [trusted=yes] file:/repo ./`), every installed package marked manual; `cases` run without a terminal (stdout and stderr apart), `cases_tty` with docker exec -t (stdout and stderr together); each case is [stdout, stderr, status]
_source.flags: none, -q, -qq, -q=2, --quiet, --quiet=2, -qqq, -qy (-qy: -y is added to the others for the changing commands)
_source.copy_repo: debian:12 (same digest), repository as `deb [trusted=yes] copy:/repo ./` so that Get: and Fetched lines appear; stdout and stderr together, the (Reading database ... N%) progress lines removed
